message.content: In the conversation, Jareth mentioned a specific side mission in Red Dead Redemption 2 that he found particularly impactful. He stated, "I remember spending time helping the townsfolk, it really added depth to Arthur's character. Like the side mission with the widow in the honor system, it was a simple act, but it really highlighted his transformation. It made me feel so connected to the world and the people in it." This side mission involved helping a widow in the honor system, which showcased Arthur's growth from a rough outlaw to someone who genuinely cared about his loved ones. This interaction added significant depth to Arthur's character and allowed players to feel more connected to the world and its inhabitants.
